description: This file defines API route handlers for an Event Booking System using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user authentication, event CRUD operations, event listing, booking, payment processing (mock), admin functions, and notification webhooks.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Extracts the current user from a JWT token provided in the query parameter.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, saves new user, and sends a welcome email.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: create_event
methods.description: Creates a new event, only accessible by organizers or admins.

methods.name: list_events
methods.description: Lists or searches events with optional filters.

methods.name: get_event
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific event by ID.

methods.name: edit_event
methods.description: Edits an existing event, accessible by admins or the event's organizer.

methods.name: delete_event
methods.description: Deletes an event, accessible by admins or the event's organizer.

methods.name: book_event
methods.description: Books tickets for an event, decreasing available seats.

methods.name: pay_booking
methods.description: Mocks payment for a booking and confirms it, sends confirmation email.

methods.name: my_bookings
methods.description: Lists bookings for the current user.

methods.name: admin_events
methods.description: Lists all events for admin moderation.

methods.name: admin_analytics
methods.description: Provides simple metrics for admin overview.

methods.name: webhook_email
methods.description: Webhook endpoint to trigger email sending (stub).
